land.text: Thaton and Lower Burma (Ramannadesa): a Mon kingdom 'essentially a city-state centered on the city of Thaton' on the Gulf of Martaban

successors.note: Pagan's ledger gains 'Lower Burma' from 'mon-city-states' on 17 May 1057; Wareru's Hanthawaddy (hanthawaddy-kingdom) restores Mon rule in 1287.

capitals.name: Thaton
capitals.note: 'The capital, Thaton, was originally a very active port on the Gulf of Martaban'; now about 12 km from the sea.

correction.text: Thaton and Lower Burma (Ramannadesa): a Mon kingdom 'essentially a city-state centered on the city of Thaton' on the Gulf of Martaban

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria has no Mon row; its Pagan Kingdom 1056 shape later adds 212 cells of Lower Burma, which is this land). The page gives a city-state around Thaton, Mon State today, with sites at Suvarnabhumi City (Bilin), Winka, Kyaikkatha and Kelasa, and no frontier or area. The whole of Lower Burma is drawn because Pagan's dossier takes it all in 1057; it is a generous reading (the page warns Lower Burma 'may have lacked a substantial independent polity'). Infobox area: not in source.

region.text: Thaton and Lower Burma (Ramannadesa): a Mon kingdom 'essentially a city-state centered on the city of Thaton' on the Gulf of Martaban

ledger.note: c. 825: the Mon kingdom of Thaton. The page says it 'probably came into existence some time in the 9th century' and its Mon kingdoms timeline reads 825?-1057?; Harvey's 825 for Pegu (Shwemawdaw Thamaing) 'remains unattested'. Tradition dates the kingdom to the 6th century BCE, which the page does not accept as history.

region.text: Thaton and Lower Burma (Ramannadesa): a Mon kingdom 'essentially a city-state centered on the city of Thaton' on the Gulf of Martaban

ledger.note: 17 May 1057: Anawrahta's Pagan takes Thaton. 'Thaton was overrun by the Pagan kingdom from Upper Burma in 1057'; Manuha surrendered after a three-month siege, 'reportedly on 17 May 1057'. The page names the city, not the land: Lower Burma is the pagan-kingdom dossier's reading.

region.text: Thaton and Lower Burma (Ramannadesa): a Mon kingdom 'essentially a city-state centered on the city of Thaton' on the Gulf of Martaban

ledger.note: 1057: the Mon kingdom of Thaton ends. 'The Pagan conquest ended the kingdom in 1057'; Mon craftsmen then built monuments at Pagan, and the Mon 'had to wait until 1287 to regain their independence' under Wareru's Hanthawaddy.

wars.name: Pagan conquest of Thaton

zones.text: Thaton and Lower Burma (Ramannadesa): a Mon kingdom 'essentially a city-state centered on the city of Thaton' on the Gulf of Martaban

wars.outcome: Pagan takes Thaton after a three-month siege, reportedly on 17 May 1057, and Lower Burma passes to Pagan.
wars.note: The chronicles treat Thaton's refusal of the Pali Canon as the pretext; the page doubts the chronicles' Mon-centred story (Aung-Thwin).

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary; the extent is the whole of Lower Burma as the pagan-kingdom dossier takes it.

sources.title: Thaton Kingdom
sources.note: Identity, capital, the hedged 9th-century origin (825?-1057?), the 1057 Pagan conquest, the Khmer encroachment, the historicity warnings. No area.

notes: State Cliopatria lacks; named by se-01-a, se-01-c (pagan-kingdom's 1057 counterpart 'mon-city-states') and others. One page opened (a single-polity article; budget 1-2). Not settled: (1) the page warns that Lower Burma 'may have lacked a substantial independent polity' before Pagan and that Mon influence on the interior is 'a greatly exaggerated post-Pagan legend' (Aung-Thwin), so this dossier is the weakest kind of state on the map: soft, hedged, 825 is the timeline's questioned year; (2) the page gives a Thai view (the Northern Chronicle puts the coast under the Monic Mueang Chaliang from the 950s to 1057) and Khmer encroachment on the Tenasserim coast, undated; (3) Pegu's founding is 573 (tradition) or 825 (a chronicle, unattested), first documented in 1266; (4) the Mon of Pegu as Pagan's vassal after 1057 is in pagan-kingdom's ledger; (5) Michen, Bassein and Martaban are not in the page. Slug 'mon-city-states' matches the counterpart string in pagan-kingdom.
